name: io.github.cgallic/wpguard-mcp
title: WPGuard MCP
description: WordPress edit previews, scoped correction checks, and change records for trusted operators.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by a space and the same WPGUARD_MCP_TOKEN configured below.

runtimeArguments.name: --publish
runtimeArguments.description: Expose the MCP endpoint on host loopback only.

runtimeArguments.name: --volume
runtimeArguments.description: Persist the private site registry, corrections, and change records.

environmentVariables.name: WPGUARD_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Generate a strong secret for trusted operators. This token grants admin tool access.
